mapper.select: WITH defaults AS ( SELECT n AS pay_odr_no, CASE n WHEN 1 THEN 10 WHEN 2 THEN 15 WHEN 3 THEN 20 ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM (to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day'))::int END AS day FROM generate_series(1,4) n ), orders AS ( SELECT d.pay_odr_no,COALESCE(o.pay_dt,to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+d.day-1) AS planned_date FROM defaults d LEFT JOIN fin.pay_odr o ON o.pay_ym=#{month} AND o.pay_odr_no=d.pay_odr_no UNION ALL SELECT pay_odr_no,pay_dt FROM fin.pay_odr WHERE pay_ym=#{month} AND pay_odr_no=5 ) SELECT o.pay_odr_no,o.planned_date,EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM fin.pay p WHERE p.pay_ym=#{month} AND p.pay_odr_no=o.pay_odr_no AND (p.pay_stts_cd='PAID' OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.pay_amt),0) FROM fin.pay_execution e WHERE e.pay_id=p.pay_id)>0) ) AS paid FROM orders o ORDER BY o.pay_odr_no
SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT pay_id FROM fin.pay WHERE pay_ym=#{month} ORDER BY pay_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin.pay_odr(pay_ym,pay_odr_no,pay_dt) VALUES(#{month},#{order.pay_odr_no},#{order.planned_date}) ON CONFLICT(pay_ym,pay_odr_no) DO UPDATE SET pay_dt=EXCLUDED.pay_dt
